{{Quote|You ever run a job out to Zekulae, at the heart of the Zeemacht Cluster, lift your eyes from the comm for a minute. You'll be staring up at a matrix of bright orange and red giants, neutron stars, pulsars, and blue stragglers the Zeku call the Cosm's Well. It's about the most beautiful thing I've ever seen that I couldn't buy or sell, and that's saying something.|[[Crix Q5 Baobab]]|<ref name="TEA" />}}
An '''orange giant''' was a type of [[Star/Legends|star]]. [[Kidros]] and [[Sacorria (star)|Sacorria]] were [[Color/Legends|orange]] [[Giant star|giants]].<ref name="PotG3" /><ref name="CatCW" /> The [[Star cluster/Legends|globular cluster]] which the [[Zeku]] called [[Cosm's Well/Legends|Cosm's Well]] was made up of orange giants, as well as [[Red giant/Legends|red giants]], [[Neutron star/Legends|neutron stars]], [[Pulsar/Legends|pulsars]] and [[blue straggler]]s.<ref name="TEA" />
